name: Turker Vangolu Enerji Yatirim A.S.
summary: Turker Vangolu Enerji Yatirim Anonim Sirketi engages in the distribution of electrical energy in Van, Mus, Hakkâri, and Bitlis. The company also engages in the retail sale and supply of electricity, and wholesale electricity trading businesses. In addition, it offers field services that include fault repair and maintenance, facility construction, and leasing services. The company was formerly known as Toprakkale Reklam Büro Hizmetleri Temizlik ve Gida Ticaret Anonim Sirketi and changed its name to Turker Vangolu Enerji Yatirim Anonim Sirketi in October 2023. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Ankara, Turkey. Turker Vangolu Enerji Yatirim Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Turkerler Insaat Turizm Madencilik Enerji Uretim Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S.
